source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Unresolved: validate only the default PCIe Compliance Mode and normal reboot, or deliberately change the compliance-mode setting and verify persistence and link/device consequences.
original_method: The primary Procedure requires Load Default, all/random non-default changes and persistence, while the same-row DeepSeek command explicitly performs only a default check and reboot. One coherent operation must be selected before execution.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer must inspect and possibly change the BIOS Compliance Mode and visually verify its state. No firmware action is authorized under the conflicting operation definitions.
required_inputs: Owner decision: default-only observation or writable persistence test
Platform definition of Compliance Mode, affected root ports/lanes and whether it emits compliance patterns or changes training
Exact default and, if applicable, approved non-default value
Expected device enumeration/link state and any external compliance-instrument requirement
Independent console/OOB, known-good boot path and restoration method
safety_requirements: Do not enable PCIe compliance/test mode or apply random chipset settings while scope is unresolved.
Compliance mode may suppress normal link training or produce test patterns; exclude production endpoints and active workloads.
Protect boot storage, management NIC, GPU and other critical devices on affected ports.
Preserve pre-change PCIe topology, link/resource and AER/RAS evidence; do not clear the only diagnostics.
Stop on critical-device loss, abnormal link state, boot failure or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Before correction, preserve source conflict and read-only baseline requirements only.
After correction, collect read-only persistent PCIe identities, topology, negotiated link state, resources, AER/RAS, boot and BMC evidence around operator phases.
Do not drive BIOS, enable compliance mode, operate test instrumentation or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Resolve and approve one coherent scope with expected evidence and restoration.
Map affected ports/endpoints and perform any corrected BIOS observation/change using safe recovery.
Interpret firmware, link and device evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its default-only manual check is internally safe but materially narrower than the preserved Procedure and Criteria; it cannot silently replace them.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No execution method is recommended until scope is corrected. Then preserve the firmware method and collect version-recorded PCIe link/topology/RAS evidence appropriate to the chosen scope.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The null script and 5/10-minute fields are preserved. The conflict between default-only and persistence operations remains explicit.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For default-only scope, capture the exact field and verify normal link/device health. For settings scope, identify affected ports, approved mode transition, expected training or compliance pattern, reset requirement, instrumentation and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact AMD chipset/root-port implementation and populated PCIe topology after owner correction.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/AGESA/BMC, endpoint firmware, OS/kernel/driver and any compliance-instrument versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform PCIe Compliance Mode documentation and, if applicable, approved PCI-SIG/vendor compliance procedure.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Separates passive default inspection from an active compliance/test-mode transition.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents invalid mixed evidence; final coverage depends on the chosen scope.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Scope, field semantics, ports, expected link behavior, instrumentation and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS enumeration cannot validate an electrical compliance pattern; instrumented compliance is a distinct scope.

project_override_considerations: A project can choose default-only or active-mode scope, but must record the choice and affected links; it cannot claim electrical compliance from firmware screenshots and OS enumeration alone.
expected_evidence: Owner-approved corrected scope and aligned Procedure/Criteria/command
Platform identity, field semantics, affected port/endpoint map and recovery
Default-only: BIOS value plus normal topology/link/device/reboot evidence
Settings scope: approved change/persistence plus expected link or instrumented behavior
Final restored state, anomalies and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source Procedure explicitly requires a non-default change and persistence, while its same-row AI command explicitly performs only a default-value check and reboot. These scopes produce different evidence and risk and cannot both define the operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core operation is genuinely unresolved, and enabling a test/compliance mode without knowing the intended scope can remove links or require instrumentation. Missing project parameters alone are not the blocker.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Preserves its manual boundary but rejects the unapproved narrowing from the primary Procedure to default-only inspection.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with BLOCKED and strengthens the link/port/instrumentation distinction.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Treats same-row derived text as subordinate to original source facts and does not silently overwrite the primary Procedure.

review_improvement: Prevents a default screenshot from being accepted as a persistence or electrical-compliance test and prevents unsafe activation of an undefined test mode.
independent_technical_reasoning: Default inspection and active PCIe compliance-mode testing are materially different operations. Because the source artifacts conflict on that core operation, safe execution is impossible until corrected.
no_automatic_retry: No execution or retry is authorized before scope correction; afterward, preserve the first link, device, boot or management anomaly and obtain engineer disposition.
